name: @wawjs/react-prime
author: Web Art Work
description: react-prime is an independent MIT-licensed React UI component library continuing from the PrimeReact 10.9.9 codebase.

scripts.build:lib: NODE_ENV=production INPUT_DIR=components/lib/ OUTPUT_DIR=dist/ npm run build:package
scripts.build:lib:windows: set "NODE_ENV=production" && set "INPUT_DIR=components/lib/" && set "OUTPUT_DIR=dist/" && npm run build:package
scripts.build:package: npm run build:check && rollup -c && gulp build-resources && npm run build:api || echo "warn: build:api skipped (build-webtypes.js targets TypeDoc 0.24's Application API, incompatible with 0.28+)"
scripts.dev:link: NODE_ENV=production INPUT_DIR=components/lib/ OUTPUT_DIR=dist/ npm run build:package:dev
scripts.dev:link:windows: set "NODE_ENV=production" && set "INPUT_DIR=components/lib/" && set "OUTPUT_DIR=dist/" && npm run build:package:dev
scripts.build:package:dev: npm run build:check && gulp build-resources && (npm run build:api || echo "warn: build:api skipped (build-webtypes.js targets TypeDoc 0.24's Application API, incompatible with 0.28+)") && rollup -c --watch
scripts.build:api: npm run apiwebtypes && npm run apidoc
scripts.build:check: npm run format:check && npm run type:check && npm run security:check
